From d837fbee92453fbb829f950c8e7cf76207d73f33 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jamal Hadi Salim <jhs@mojatatu.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 11:02:42 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] net/sched: qfq: Use cl_is_active to determine whether class
 is active in qfq_rm_from_ag

This is more of a preventive patch to make the code more consistent and
to prevent possible exploits that employ child qlen manipulations on qfq.
use cl_is_active instead of relying on the child qdisc's qlen to determine
class activation.

Fixes: 462dbc9101acd ("pkt_sched: QFQ Plus: fair-queueing service at DRR cost")
Signed-off-by: Jamal Hadi Salim <jhs@mojatatu.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260114160243.913069-3-jhs@mojatatu.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/sched/sch_qfq.c b/net/sched/sch_qfq.c
index 9d59090bbe93..e7778413e72f 100644
--- a/net/sched/sch_qfq.c
+++ b/net/sched/sch_qfq.c
@@ -373,7 +373,7 @@ static void qfq_rm_from_agg(struct qfq_sched *q, struct qfq_class *cl)
 /* Deschedule class and remove it from its parent aggregate. */
 static void qfq_deact_rm_from_agg(struct qfq_sched *q, struct qfq_class *cl)
 {
-	if (cl->qdisc->q.qlen > 0) /* class is active */
+	if (cl_is_active(cl)) /* class is active */
 		qfq_deactivate_class(q, cl);
 
 	qfq_rm_from_agg(q, cl);
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### Files Modified
- **net/sched/sch_qfq.c** – only one file changed.

### Specific Changes
- In function `qfq_deact_rm_from_agg`, line 376, the condition `if (cl->qdisc->q.qlen > 0)` was replaced with `if (cl_is_active(cl))`.
- All other code remains identical.

### Relationship Between Modifications
The change is a single, localized substitution within a single function. The core logic (descheduling the class if active, then removing it from its aggregate) remains unchanged. The purpose is to use the dedicated helper `cl_is_active()` instead of directly inspecting the child qdisc's packet queue length (`cl->qdisc->q.qlen`). This makes the activation check consistent with how other parts of the QFQ scheduler determine class activity and also closes potential exploits where an attacker could manipulate the child qdisc's qlen to incorrectly bypass deactivation. The patch is preventive and does not alter the intended behavior for correctly behaving classes.

Here is the commit message:
net/sched: qfq: Use cl_is_active to determine whether class
 is active in qfq_rm_from_ag

This is more of a preventive patch to make the code more consistent and
to prevent possible exploits that employ child qlen manipulations on qfq.
use cl_is_active instead of relying on the child qdisc's qlen to determine
class activation.

Fixes: 462dbc9101acd ("pkt_sched: QFQ Plus: fair-queueing service at DRR cost")
Signed-off-by: Jamal Hadi Salim <jhs@mojatatu.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260114160243.913069-3-jhs@mojatatu.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The bug is a logic error caused by relying on the child qdisc's queue length (`cl->qdisc->q.qlen > 0`) to determine whether a class is active in the QFQ scheduler. This approach is inconsistent with the rest of the scheduler's activation tracking and is vulnerable to exploitation via malicious manipulation of the child qdisc's qlen (e.g., by direct enqueue/dequeue operations that bypass QFQ's accounting). The correct and secure method is to use the dedicated helper `cl_is_active()`, which checks the scheduler's own activation state rather than depending on external queue lengths. Using the wrong check can lead to incorrect deactivation decisions, potentially causing incorrect scheduling behavior or security exploits.

Here is the patch:
 /* Deschedule class and remove it from its parent aggregate. */
 static void qfq_deact_rm_from_agg(struct qfq_sched *q, struct qfq_class *cl)
 {
-	if (cl->qdisc->q.qlen > 0) /* class is active */
+	if (cl_is_active(cl)) /* class is active */
 		qfq_deactivate_class(q, cl);
 
 	qfq_rm_from_agg(q, cl);
 }
